<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Get remaining gray bars
seg = current_frame.segmentation
remaining = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'w':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        rmin, rmax = min(rows), max(rows)
        cmin, cmax = min(cols), max(cols)
        center_r = (rmin + rmax) // 2
        center_c = (cmin + cmax) // 2
        remaining.append((center_r, center_c))

print(f"Remaining: {len(remaining)}")
# Sort by row then col for consistent ordering
remaining.sort()
for r, c in remaining:
    print(f"  ({r}, {c})")

# Click first batch of 8
batch = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in remaining[:8]]
action(batch, intent='solve')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
